verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports autonomous background behavior via automatic PR review checks triggered on push, an agent that reads feedback submissions and proposes tasks/intentions unattended, and CLI/cron-friendly automation (usable 'from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron'). However, this is mostly reactive automation (triggered by PRs or feedback events) rather than a general-purpose scheduled/background agent framework, and there's no first-party scheduler or evidence of independent/hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: evidence of a native scheduling/trigger system beyond PR and feedback events, independent verification of autonomous run reliability, and broader documentation of arbitrary background automations.
